title: Why did Duterte list Gencorp in SALN? Too precious to lose – witness Cabrera

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Food company GenCorp Industries Inc. remained part of Vice President Sara Duterte’s business interests under her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) — even if the firm does not list her as an incorporator — because it is too precious to lose. This is was a witness at Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday said. Public prosecutor and Akbayan party-list Rep. Chel Diokno asked their witness – financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera – what could have been the reason why Duterte still listed Gencorp in her SALN, even if her name is absent from the company’s General Information […]...
